8a192aa632f8b2bff7c8505eb7adb9a099df882e.definition: Authority whose basis can be named and questioned, such as checked knowledge, a defined role or a rule that applies to everybody.
8a192aa632f8b2bff7c8505eb7adb9a099df882e.gloss: Authority whose basis can be named and questioned, such as checked knowledge, a defined role or a rule that applies to everybody.

8a192aa632f8b2bff7c8505eb7adb9a099df882e.definition: 根拠を明示し、それについて異議を唱えられる権威。検証された知識、明確な役割、 everyone's rules などの根拠に基づく。
8a192aa632f8b2bff7c8505eb7adb9a099df882e.gloss: 根拠を示して問いただせる権威。

8a192aa632f8b2bff7c8505eb7adb9a099df882e.definition: 검증된 지식, 명확한 역할 또는 모두가 따르는 규칙처럼 이유를 제시하고 질문을 받아들일 수 있는 권위이다. 공식적으로 주어졌다는 사실만으로는 정당하다고 볼 수 없다.
8a192aa632f8b2bff7c8505eb7adb9a099df882e.gloss: 근거를 밝히고 검토받을 수 있는 권위.

8a192aa632f8b2bff7c8505eb7adb9a099df882e.definition: Autoridade baseada em conhecimento verificado, função definida ou regra aplicável a todos, fundamentos que podem ser identificados e questionados.
8a192aa632f8b2bff7c8505eb7adb9a099df882e.gloss: Autoridade cujo fundamento pode ser identificado e questionado.

8a192aa632f8b2bff7c8505eb7adb9a099df882e.definition: Kewenangan yang sah karena bersumber pada pengetahuan yang telah diperiksa, peran yang jelas, atau aturan yang berlaku bagi semua orang. Kewenangan ini tetap dapat dipertanyakan bila alasan atau batasannya tidak Dip nerf-deficient.
8a192aa632f8b2bff7c8505eb7adb9a099df882e.gloss: Kewenangan yang dasar dan batasannya dapat dijelaskan serta diperiksa.

8a192aa632f8b2bff7c8505eb7adb9a099df882e.definition: อำนาจที่มีแหล่งที่มาหรือเหตุผลรองรับซึ่งสามารถตรวจสอบและตั้งคำถามได้ เช่น ความรู้ที่ตรวจสอบแล้ว หน้าที่ที่กำหนดไว้ หรือกฎที่ใช้กับทุกคน
8a192aa632f8b2bff7c8505eb7adb9a099df882e.gloss: อำนาจที่มีเหตุผลและหลักฐานรองรับชัดเจน

8a192aa632f8b2bff7c8505eb7adb9a099df882e.definition: Meşru otoritenin dayanağı denetlenmiş bilgi, belirlenmiş bir görev ya da herkesi kapsayan bir kural olabilir. Dayanağı belirtilemeyen veya sorgulanamayan yetki meşru sayılmaz.
8a192aa632f8b2bff7c8505eb7adb9a099df882e.gloss: Meşru otorite, dayanağı açıklanabilir ve sorgulanabilir olan yetkidir.

8a192aa632f8b2bff7c8505eb7adb9a099df882e.translation: Bu meşru otoriteydi: standardı gösterdi ve kuralı kimin imzaladığını açıkladı.
นี่คืออำนาจที่ชอบธรรม เพราะเธอแสดงมาตรฐานและระบุว่าใครเป็นผู้ลงนามในกฎ
Ia exercising kewenangan sah karena menunjukkan standar yang digunakan dan siapa yang telah menandatangani aturan tersebut.
Era autoridade legítima: ela apresentou a norma e informou quem a havia assinado.
이는 정당한 권위였다. 그는 기준을 제시하고 그 규칙에 서명한 사람이 누구인지 밝혔다.
これは正当な権威だった。彼女は基準を示し、誰が規則に署名したかを明かした。

8a192aa632f8b2bff7c8505eb7adb9a099df882e.text: It was legitimate authority: she showed the standard and said who had signed the rule.
8a192aa632f8b2bff7c8505eb7adb9a099df882e.translation: Đó là uy quyền hợp pháp: cô ấy giơ bảng tiêu chuẩn lên và nói ai đã ký quy định.

8a2e2ca065fcaecd435d0df511da99943850e445.definition: Pairing with a person who has less of a valued resource, such as income, education or position, than the chooser.
8a2e2ca065fcaecd435d0df511da99943850e445.gloss: Pairing with a person who has less of a valued resource, such as income, education or position, than the chooser.

8a2e2ca065fcaecd435d0df511da99943850e445.definition: 相手よりも収入や教育、社会的な地位など、重視される資源を少なく持つ人と結婚や交際すること。視点が変われば、上婚とも呼ばれる。
8a2e2ca065fcaecd435d0df511da99943850e445.gloss: 収入や地位など、重視される資源が相手より少ない人と組になること。

8a2e2ca065fcaecd435d0df511da99943850e445.definition: 선택하는 사람보다 수입이나 교육, 위치 등이 적은 사람과 짝이 되는 방향. 상대 입장에서는 바로 그 짝이 고배가 되므로 두 말은 같은 현상에서 쓰인다.
8a2e2ca065fcaecd435d0df511da99943850e445.gloss: 자기보다 Valuable 자원이 적은 사람과 짝이 되는 것.

8a2e2ca065fcaecd435d0df511da99943850e445.definition: É o casamento ou relacionamento em que uma pessoa escolhe um parceiro com menor renda, formação ou prestígio social. A classificação varia conforme a posição de quem faz a comparação.
8a2e2ca065fcaecd435d0df511da99943850e445.gloss: União com alguém que possui menos recursos ou posição social.

8a2e2ca065fcaecd435d0df511da99943850e445.definition: Berpasangan dengan orang yang memiliki lebih sedikit sumber daya bernilai, seperti penghasilan, pendidikan, atau kedudukan, daripada oneself. Istilah ini merupakan kebalikan dari hipergami dan juga bergantung pada sudut pandang.
8a2e2ca065fcaecd435d0df511da99943850e445.gloss: Berpasangan dengan orang yang memiliki lebih sedikit sumber daya bernilai daripada diri sendiri.

8a2e2ca065fcaecd435d0df511da99943850e445.definition: หมายถึงการจับคู่กับบุคคลที่มีทรัพยากรที่สังคมให้คุณค่า อย่างรายได้ การศึกษา หรือตำแหน่ง น้อยกว่าผู้เลือก การจับคู่แบบเดียวกันอาจถูกมองตรงข้ามกันได้จากอีกฝ่ายหนึ่ง
8a2e2ca065fcaecd435d0df511da99943850e445.gloss: การเข้าคู่กับผู้ที่มีทรัพยากรอันค่านิยมน้อยกว่า

8a2e2ca065fcaecd435d0df511da99943850e445.definition: Toplumsal eşleşmede eş seçen kişinin gelir, eğitim, konum ya da başka bir değerli kaynak bakımından eşinden daha az avantajlı olması. Aynı eşleşme, diğer eşin bakış açısından hipergami olabilir.
8a2e2ca065fcaecd435d0df511da99943850e445.gloss: Kendinden daha az değerli kaynağa sahip biriyle eşleşme.

8a2e2ca065fcaecd435d0df511da99943850e445.translation: Bir eş daha çok kazandığında eşleşme bir taraftan hipogami, diğer taraftan hipergamidir.
หากคู่หนึ่งมีรายได้มากกว่า การเข้าคู่กับผู้ที่มีทรัพยากรอันค่านิยมน้อยกว่าจะมองได้จากฝ่ายที่มีรายได้มากกว่า
Ketika satu pasangan menghasilkan lebih banyak, hubungan itu disebut hipogami dari sisi orang yang penghasilannya lebih tinggi.
Quando um parceiro ganha mais, o casamento é hipogamia para quem ganha menos e hipergamia para quem ganha mais.
한쪽이 더 많이 벌면 그 짝은 한쪽에서 보아 저배이고 다른 쪽에서 보아 고배이다.
片方の収入が高ければ、その関係は片方から見ると下婚、他方から見ると上婚になる。

8a2e2ca065fcaecd435d0df511da99943850e445.text: When one partner earns more, the pairing is hypogamy from one side and hypergamy from the other.

8a39178d327e72a92d3b9800e55c5e95930f7ef6.gloss: Forma redonda e plana, sem cantos.

8a6cead4385ed4394247b71692fb729b0563f8e1.gloss: Longa viagem anual feita por animais em busca de alimento e condições adequadas.

8a6cead4385ed4394247b71692fb729b0563f8e1.gloss: Perjalanan panjang yang dilakukan hewan setiap tahun.
